behaviour:
Calculate the standard octile distance between two grid points.

>>> round(octile_distance((0, 0), (3, 4)), 4)
5.2426
>>> round(octile_distance((0, 0), (0, 0)), 4)
0.0

Implements weighted A* search on an obstacle grid.

>>> algo = WeightedAStar((0,0), (5,5), 1.5)
>>> len(algo.neighbors(3, 3)) > 0
True
